name: Prep for a QBR
tagline: Pull meeting context → human reviews → posts the brief to Slack
description: Two-phase task to prep for a Quarterly Business Review. Phase 1 runs the meeting-prep workflow (pulls Gmail history with the attendees, drafts a brief, posts to Slack). Phase 2 is a human-gate so the AE can read and approve the brief before sharing it externally.

phases.name: AE reviews the brief
phases.human_instructions: Read the brief in Slack. If anything is wrong or missing, reject with notes and I'll re-pull. Otherwise approve to close out.
